about: What the MEDS_extract-INSPIRE runner (INSPIRE_MEDS 291c948, MEDS-Extract 0.8.0) built from the synthetic release of tests/conftest.py with --no-enrich: each code's description and number of events. tests/test_runner_equivalence.py checks that meds-extract-run spec=INSPIRE still builds it. Its ICD codes were later renamed to the ICD//<edition>// layout (README, Breaking changes).

ADMISSION_DEPARTMENT//CS.description: Surgical department for admission: Cardiothoracic surgery (INSPIRE operations.department 'CS', expanded by the release's department.csv)

ADMISSION_DEPARTMENT//GS.description: Surgical department for admission: General surgery (INSPIRE operations.department 'GS', expanded by the release's department.csv)

ANESTHESIA_TYPE//General.description: Anesthesia type: General (INSPIRE operations.antype: General, Neuraxial, Regional, or MAC = monitored anesthesia care)

ANESTHESIA_TYPE//Regional.description: Anesthesia type: Regional (INSPIRE operations.antype: General, Neuraxial, Regional, or MAC = monitored anesthesia care)

ASA//2.description: ASA physical status 2, mild systemic disease (INSPIRE operations.asa)

ASA//3.description: ASA physical status 3, severe systemic disease (INSPIRE operations.asa)

EMERGENCY_OPERATION//0.description: Emergency operation flag: 0 (INSPIRE operations.emop, binary indicator of an emergency operation)

EMERGENCY_OPERATION//1.description: Emergency operation flag: 1 (INSPIRE operations.emop, binary indicator of an emergency operation)

HEIGHT.description: Body height measured before the operation, cm (INSPIRE operations.height)

ICD//10PCS//02HV3.description: Operation, ICD-10-PCS code cut to its first five characters (section, body system, root operation, body part, approach): 02HV3 (INSPIRE operations.icd10_pcs; up to INSPIRE 1.4.2 predicted from the procedure name by a model)

ICD//10PCS//0DTJ4.description: Operation, ICD-10-PCS code cut to its first five characters (section, body system, root operation, body part, approach): 0DTJ4 (INSPIRE operations.icd10_pcs; up to INSPIRE 1.4.2 predicted from the procedure name by a model)

ICD//10PCS//5A195.description: Operation, ICD-10-PCS code cut to its first five characters (section, body system, root operation, body part, approach): 5A195 (INSPIRE operations.icd10_pcs; up to INSPIRE 1.4.2 predicted from the procedure name by a model)

ICD//10PCS//UNK.description: Operation, ICD-10-PCS code cut to its first five characters (section, body system, root operation, body part, approach): UNK (INSPIRE operations.icd10_pcs; up to INSPIRE 1.4.2 predicted from the procedure name by a model)

ICU_ADMISSION.description: ICU admission recorded on an operation (INSPIRE operations.icuin_time); meant as the ICU stay after surgery, but up to INSPIRE 1.4.2 linked to operations by patient only, so some stays do not follow an operation of the same admission

ICU_DISCHARGE.description: ICU discharge recorded on an operation (INSPIRE operations.icuout_time); meant as the end of the ICU stay after surgery, but up to INSPIRE 1.4.2 linked to operations by patient only, so some stays do not follow an operation of the same admission

MEDICATION//B05XA03//IV.description: Medication administered, WHO ATC code B05XA03, route IV (INSPIRE medications.atc_code and route; the ingredient name is in text_value). An administered order without dose or amount; a combination product is one event per component

MEDICATION//N02BE//IV.description: Medication administered, WHO ATC code N02BE, route IV (INSPIRE medications.atc_code and route; the ingredient name is in text_value). An administered order without dose or amount; a combination product is one event per component

MEDICATION//N02BE01//IV.description: Medication administered, WHO ATC code N02BE01, route IV (INSPIRE medications.atc_code and route; the ingredient name is in text_value). An administered order without dose or amount; a combination product is one event per component

MEDICATION//UNK//PO.description: Medication administered, WHO ATC code UNK, route PO (INSPIRE medications.atc_code and route; the ingredient name is in text_value). An administered order without dose or amount; a combination product is one event per component

MEDS_BIRTH.description: Birth (MEDS standard code); estimated as the date of the patient's first operation in their first admission minus the age recorded on it, which INSPIRE rounds to the nearest five years (operations.age; not top-coded, 90 is the highest level), so it is uncertain by up to 2.5 years

MEDS_DEATH.description: Death (MEDS standard code); the in-hospital death time from the EMR (operations.inhosp_death_time) where there is one, else 00:00 of the date the death was registered with the Korean Ministry of the Interior and Safety (allcause_death_time, a median of about 11 days after the death; follow-up to 2023-06-15). About 2% of patients could not be linked to the registry, so no event means no recorded death, not survival

OPERATION_ID.description: Operation identifier, in text_value, recorded at the operation start (INSPIRE operations.op_id; a random number beginning with 4)

OR_IN.description: Patient entered the operating room (INSPIRE operations.orin_time)

OR_OUT.description: Patient left the operating room (INSPIRE operations.orout_time)

RACE//Asian.description: Race of the patient: Asian (INSPIRE operations.race)

SEX//F.description: Sex of the patient: F (INSPIRE operations.sex, M or F)

SEX//M.description: Sex of the patient: M (INSPIRE operations.sex, M or F)

VITALDB_CASE_ID.description: Identifier of the same case in the open VitalDB dataset, in text_value; a static (untimed) event (INSPIRE operations.case_id)

WEIGHT.description: Body weight measured before the operation, kg (INSPIRE operations.weight)
